quantity.additive: current final max HP times percentage is added to the flat ATK term, before defense; original ATK percent and flat remain
quantity.replacement: current final max HP times percentage replaces skill base ATK; original ATK percent and flat do not apply; defense and damage/crit layers remain
quantity.scope: Per-skill basis, not a persistent ATK buff or hit-count multiplier
quantity.rounding: Preserve flat-term grouping and existing final damage rounding

ammo.trigger: At least one negative source-group percentage has the exclusive flag
ammo.selection: Keep one most-negative percentage group across all reductions, including unflagged groups; ties keep first; all nonnegative groups remain
ammo.rounding: Compare group sums before per-group ammunition rounding; apply magazine minimum afterward
ammo.inactive: Zero/positive exclusive group and expired/removed carriers do not suppress other reductions
ammo.execution: One grouped reduction path shared by stat query and effective magazine; old paths unchanged if feature absent
